name: Classic Car
description: Classic cars are the unified name given to vintage cars by car enthusiasts around the world, generally referring to cars from before World War II or older. Classic cars are a product of nostalgia, but not every old car qualifies as a classic car. Good maintenance is an important prerequisite. Excellent design, high-standard design and manufacturing processes are also factors that consider the value of the car. At present, more and more people are paying attention to classic cars, and the value of classic cars continues to rise. Classic car collection not only has the function of entertainment, relaxation and socialization, but also contains the possibility of obtaining return on investment.
